passwordReset.subject: Reset Your {{appName}} Password
passwordReset.heading: The keys to your story.
passwordReset.body1: Someone requested to reset your password for {{appName}}. If that was you, the path forward lies below.
passwordReset.body2: Click the button to reclaim your narrative — your account, your secrets, your next chapter.
passwordReset.footer2: If you didn't request this, ignore this message — your story remains secure, and no changes have been made.
verification.subject: Verify Your {{appName}} Email
verification.heading: One step closer to the story.
verification.body1: You've chosen to enter {{appName}} — a world where every choice ripples through the narrative. But first, you must confirm your identity.
verification.body2: Or click the button below to verify your email directly:
verification.footer1: This verification code expires in 24 hours.
verification.footer2: If you didn't create an account, no action is needed — this code will expire on its own.
welcome.subject: Welcome to {{appName}}!
welcome.heading: The story begins, {{username}}.
welcome.body1: You've stepped into {{appName}} — where every choice shapes reality, and every decision could be your last.
welcome.body2: This isn't just a platform. It's a living narrative engine that responds to your every move, twisting and turning with the weight of your choices.
welcome.body3: Create stories that grip readers by the throat. Explore narratives that fight back. Build worlds where nothing is as it seems.
welcome.body4: I'm Taufik, the creator of {{appName}}. I built this because I believe stories should be more than words on a page — they should be experiences that leave you breathless.
welcome.body5: Your first chapter awaits. Dive in, and remember: in {{appName}}, the story never ends the way you expect.
welcome.footer:
See you in the narrative,
Taufik
Creator, {{appName}}
passwordChanged.subject: Your {{appName}} password was changed
passwordChanged.heading: Password updated, {{name}}.
passwordChanged.body2: If you made this change, no further action is needed.
passwordChanged.body3: If you did not change your password, reset it immediately and contact support.
passwordChanged.footer: This is a security notification. We always send these when your password changes.
emailChanged.subject: Your {{appName}} email address was changed
emailChanged.heading: Email updated, {{name}}.
emailChanged.body1: The login email on your {{appName}} account was changed to {{newEmailMasked}}.
emailChanged.body2: If you made this change, you can ignore this message. A verification email was sent to the new address.
emailChanged.body3: If you did not request this, reset your password immediately and contact support.
emailChanged.footer: This is a security notification. We always send these when your login email changes.
accountDeleted.subject: Your {{appName}} account has been deleted
accountDeleted.heading: The file is closed, {{name}}.
accountDeleted.body1: Your {{appName}} account and associated personal data have been deleted as requested.
accountDeleted.body2: We're sorry to see you go. If this was a mistake, you can create a new account — the previous one cannot be restored.
accountDeleted.footer: This confirmation is sent once when an account is deleted.
trialEnding.subject: Your {{appName}} VIP Trial Ends Soon
trialEnding.heading: The clock is ticking, {{name}}.
trialEnding.body1: Your VIP access to {{appName}} — the badge, the 2x check-in bonus, your monthly credits — is set to expire on {{date}}.
trialEnding.body2: After that date, we'll charge your card on file to continue the membership. No interruptions, no gaps in your story.
trialEnding.body3: If your payment method has changed or you'd rather not continue, update your billing info or cancel anytime from your subscription settings before the trial ends.
trialEnding.footer1: Nothing to do if you're planning to stay. Your VIP benefits will continue without a hitch.
trialEnding.footer2: {{date}} — when the trial ends, the real story begins.
paymentFailed.subject: Action needed: {{appName}} payment failed
paymentFailed.heading: The trail went cold, {{name}}.
paymentFailed.body1: We couldn't process your latest {{appName}} VIP payment. Your membership is marked past due.
paymentFailed.body2: Update your payment method so the badge, credits, and 2× check-in don't slip into the dark.
paymentFailed.footer: Already fixed the card? You can ignore this — the next charge will try again on its own.
refund.subject: Refund processed — {{appName}}
refund.heading: The deal is reversed, {{name}}.
refund.body1: A refund on your {{appName}} purchase has gone through.
refund.body2: To keep the books balanced, {{credits}} credit(s) have been pulled from your balance.
refund.footer: Your bank or card issuer may take a few business days to show the refund on your statement.
subCanceled.subject: Your {{appName}} VIP subscription was canceled
subCanceled.heading: This chapter ends, {{name}}.
subCanceled.body1: Your {{appName}} VIP subscription has been canceled.
subCanceled.accessUntil: VIP access holds until {{date}} — then the lights dim and your account returns to standard.
subCanceled.accessGeneric: Your VIP benefits will end with the current billing period.
subCanceled.body2: The door stays open. Resubscribe anytime from your account settings when you're ready for the next act.
feedbackAck.subject: We Received Your Feedback — {{appName}}
feedbackAck.heading: Thank you for reaching out, {{name}}.
feedbackAck.body1: We've received your message and truly appreciate you taking the time to let us know.
feedbackAck.body2: We're sorry for any inconvenience this may have caused. Our team will review your feedback and address the issue as soon as possible.
feedbackAck.body3: Your input helps us make {{appName}} better for everyone — thank you for being part of the story.
feedbackAck.footer: No action needed on your end. We'll follow up if we need more details.
weekly.subject: This week's dossiers — {{appName}}
weekly.heading: We've been watching what you read, {{name}}.
weekly.body1: From the shadows of {{appName}}, a few stories surfaced — the kind that don't let go once you open the first page.
weekly.body2: Picked for you from the shelves that match your trail. Choose carefully. Or don't. Either way, something will change.
weekly.body3: Open one when the house is quiet. That's when they hit hardest.
weekly.footer: Too many whispers? Manage email preferences
monthly.subject: Your {{month}} dossier — {{appName}}
monthly.heading: {{month}} is closed, {{name}}.
monthly.body1: We've sealed last month's file. Here's what the record shows you did inside {{appName}}:
monthly.body2: The ledger never lies. A new month is already open — and it doesn't care how last one ended.
announcement.footer: Don't want these dispatches? Manage preferences or turn off product announcements anytime.
